g.landing.5.name: Creature lands: 5–6 power
prompts: A heavy beast dropping onto a wooden table, one deep thud and the table legs shuddering
A big armoured body landing on thick floorboards, a solid boom and the boards rattling under it
A boulder set down hard on a wooden stage, a deep dull thump and a short shake of the planks
An ogre jumping down onto a wooden floor, a heavy stomp and loose cups trembling on a shelf
A massive iron chest dropped onto a heavy oak table, a weighty thud and a brief wooden shudder

g.landing.7.name: Creature lands: 7 power
prompts: A giant landing on a stone floor, a deep boom and the stone cracking under its weight
A huge stone golem slamming down onto flagstones, a heavy impact and a sharp crack splitting the slab
A massive creature dropping onto frozen ground, a deep thud and the ice cracking outward
An enormous weight hitting a marble floor, a booming impact with a dry splitting crack
A troll king landing on cobblestones, a heavy crash and stones fracturing with a gritty crunch

g.landing.8.name: Creature lands: 8–11 power
prompts: A titan crashing down onto a stone courtyard, a huge boom, the ground cracking and crates knocked over and tumbling away
A dragon slamming onto a rocky ledge, a massive impact, cracking stone and loose rocks thrown aside clattering
A colossal beast landing in a market square, a deep boom, splitting cobbles and wooden carts and barrels knocked flying
An enormous stone giant dropping onto a hall floor, a booming crack and benches and tables shoved aside scraping
A huge creature landing hard on a wooden deck, a heavy crash, splintering boards and barrels sent rolling away

g.landing.12.name: Creature lands: 12 or more power
prompts: A mountain-sized colossus slamming into the earth, a seismic boom, the ground splitting wide and rubble thrown far in every direction, a long rumble
An ancient world-ending titan landing, an enormous deep impact, rock shattering, debris raining down and a long low tremor
A leviathan crashing onto a city plaza, a colossal boom, stone breaking apart, walls and carts knocked away and falling rubble settling
A gigantic beast dropping from the sky onto a valley, a massive ground-shaking slam, cracking bedrock, boulders tumbling and a rolling rumble
A titanic creature striking the ground, a huge deep thud, a shockwave of breaking stone and scattered debris, then a slow rumbling settle
